answer: Make identity cost a variable the network reads off your own behaviour. Each agent posts a 900 POA bond, but the bond is re-priced each epoch from its scored history: three clean reviews cut the required bond by 10%, while one failed review doubles it. A fresh key starts at the maximum 3600 POA, and a key that keeps failing climbs instead of resetting. Fifteen clones therefore need 54000 POA on day one and pay more every failure, while a proven agent needs 900. The ledge bond schedule, willow review record and oasis of scores make each price auditable.
